# UX Checklist: Analog and Digital Clock

**Purpose**: Validate the quality, clarity, completeness, and consistency of the clock's user-facing requirements before implementation
**Created**: 2026-11-10
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[X] ` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[X] ` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [X] CHK001 - Are visual requirements for every analog dial element (numerals, tick marks, hands, face) fully specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004–FR-006]
- [X] CHK002 - Is the total number of tick marks on the dial specified, including whether minute ticks exist? [Gap, Spec §FR-006]
- [X] CHK003 - Are hand appearance requirements (color, width, length) documented? [Gap, Spec §FR-004]
- [X] CHK004 - Is the full character layout of the digital readout (hour digits, separator, minutes, period) specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007–FR-009]
- [X] CHK005 - Are page-level elements such as the page title, heading, and clock labels specified? [Gap]
- [X] CHK006 - Are requirements defined for the initial state before scripts execute? [Gap, Progressive Enhancement]

## Requirement Clarity

- [X] CHK007 - Is "light red" quantified with a specific color value or design token? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006, §SC-008]
- [X] CHK008 - Is the digital clock's update frequency explicitly quantified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003]
- [X] CHK009 - Is the AM/PM indicator's format and placement specified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009]
- [X] CHK010 - Is the analog dial's size or relative sizing specified? [Gap, Clarity]
- [X] CHK011 - Is "modern desktop or mobile browser" defined with concrete browser and version support? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions]
- [X] CHK012 - Is "one update cycle" defined in time units? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Requirement Consistency

- [X] CHK013 - Do the functional requirements and the Clarifications section agree on which dial elements are light red? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005–FR-006]
- [X] CHK014 - Are all resolved clarifications recorded in the Clarifications section? [Consistency, Spec §Clarifications]
- [X] CHK015 - Do the analog and digital requirements agree that both displays use the same time snapshot? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002–FR-003]
- [X] CHK016 - Are the edge-case statements about leading zeros consistent with the digital format requirement? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007, Edge Cases]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [X] CHK017 - Can "read both clocks correctly" be objectively measured? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006]
- [X] CHK018 - Is the contrast requirement paired with a named verification method? [Measurability, Spec §SC-008]
- [X] CHK019 - Is the "every minute of the day" criterion testable within a practical validation approach? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]
- [X] CHK020 - Are acceptance scenarios defined for both AM and PM periods? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 3]

## Scenario Coverage

- [X] CHK021 - Are alternate flows defined for single-digit hours and the 12 o'clock boundaries? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [X] CHK022 - Are non-functional scenarios (offline use, tab restore, daylight-saving change) represented in acceptance criteria? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-012]
- [X] CHK023 - Are degradation requirements defined if the device clock is unavailable or unreliable? [Coverage, Gap]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [X] CHK024 - Are boundary requirements defined for the 11:59 to 12:00 and 11:59 PM to 12:00 AM transitions? [Edge Cases, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [X] CHK025 - Is behavior specified when the device time zone changes while the page is open? [Edge Cases, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [X] CHK026 - Is behavior specified when the page is backgrounded and timers are throttled? [Edge Cases, Gap]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [X] CHK027 - Are accessibility requirements for non-visual users specified beyond color contrast? [Coverage, Gap]
- [X] CHK028 - Are performance requirements defined for slow devices, not only broadband connections? [Completeness, Spec §SC-007]
- [X] CHK029 - Are privacy requirements explicit about whether any time data is collected or transmitted? [Gap, Privacy]
- [X] CHK030 - Are localization requirements for language and time format addressed or explicitly excluded? [Coverage, Gap]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [X] CHK031 - Is the dependency on the device clock documented with accuracy expectations? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [X] CHK032 - Is the 12-hour convention justified and traceable to a recorded decision? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions, §Clarifications]
- [X] CHK033 - Is the no-external-service assumption validated against the offline requirement? [Assumption, Spec §FR-012]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [X] CHK034 - Is "simple" quantified or replaced with measurable constraints? [Ambiguity]
- [X] CHK035 - Are "tick marks" and "numerals" used consistently without overlapping meaning? [Terminology, Spec §FR-005–FR-006]
- [X] CHK036 - Is the relationship between the Clarifications section and the updated requirements traceable? [Traceability, Spec §Clarifications]

## Notes

- Mark items `[X] ` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
